**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the migration introduction in the release ancestry**

Releasing this exact commit is blocked because `49ff02de5ade1b8923f099c22af0bbf57350a078` is not an ancestor of `bb894bf650ebccd3935c0cd640ec04f8eba83b5a` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` returns nonzero; its help defines the first argument as the required ancestor). The guarded release path checks every `introducedBy` value at `scripts/production-release.mjs:247-256` and will therefore abort before applying migrations. Merge the schema-introduction commit into the ancestry before this manifest registration is released.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Verified against the actual published PR heads: git merge-base --is-ancestor 49ff02de5ade1b8923f099c22af0bbf57350a078 HEAD exits 0. The normal history includes the schema introduction before manifest registration. The guarded release plan passes for the exact published head (444:9497be8f4;445:563dafa42), including all110 migrations. The temporary review commits cited here are not the release targets. No migration rewrite or squash is used; normal merge ancestry remains required. Actual plan output is retained locally for release preflight; this is planning, not deployment.
